cases.sourceText: At the fictional Vela canal station, controller Iris-7 sends an alert to technician Niko when the water rises above 83 cm. Niko receives the alert and never sends an alert to Iris-7.
cases.question: Who receives the alert from Iris-7 when water exceeds 83 cm?
cases.claim: When water exceeds 83 cm, Iris-7 sends an alert to technician Niko.

cases.sourceText: At the fictional Vela canal station, valve Mesa-2 may open only after reservoir pressure exceeds 14 bar. At 14 bar or below it stays closed. Technician Niko inspects the valve on Tuesday only when the station log is signed.
cases.question: What pressure condition is necessary for Mesa-2 to open?
cases.claim: Mesa-2 may open only after reservoir pressure exceeds 14 bar.

cases.sourceText: At the fictional Vela canal station, valve Mesa-2 may open only after reservoir pressure exceeds 14 bar. At 14 bar or below it stays closed. Technician Niko inspects the valve on Tuesday only when the station log is signed.
cases.question: When may Mesa-2 open if reservoir pressure is 14 bar?
cases.claim: Mesa-2 may open when reservoir pressure is 14 bar.

cases.sourceText: At the fictional Piper orchard, harvester Piper-4 may transport up to 18 baskets during fog; there is no minimum number of baskets. It is not required to transport exactly 18 baskets.
cases.question: How many baskets may Piper-4 transport at most during fog?
cases.claim: During fog, Piper-4 may transport at most 18 baskets.

cases.sourceText: At the fictional Piper orchard, harvester Piper-4 may transport up to 18 baskets during fog; there is no minimum number of baskets. It is not required to transport exactly 18 baskets.

cases.sourceText: At the fictional Sable packing hub, warehouse Sable hands the parcel manifest directly to courier Uma. Uma later delivers it to depot Jericho. Depot Jericho does not hand the manifest to Uma.
cases.question: Who receives the manifest directly from warehouse Sable?
cases.claim: Warehouse Sable directly hands the parcel manifest to courier Uma.

cases.sourceText: At the fictional Sable packing hub, warehouse Sable hands the parcel manifest directly to courier Uma. Uma later delivers it to depot Jericho. Depot Jericho does not hand the manifest to Uma.

cases.sourceText: En el archivo municipal ficticio Lince, el supervisor Teo autoriza la solicitud antes de que Sara reciba acceso de lectura. Sara no concede permisos ni autoriza solicitudes.
cases.question: ¿Quién autoriza la solicitud antes de que Sara reciba acceso de lectura?
cases.claim: El supervisor Teo autoriza la solicitud antes de que Sara reciba acceso de lectura.

cases.sourceText: En el repositorio ficticio Azul se conservan copias de seguridad durante 21 días. Después de 21 días se eliminan. No existe una política de conservación de 12 días.
cases.question: ¿Durante cuántos días se conservan las copias de seguridad?
cases.claim: El repositorio Azul conserva copias de seguridad durante 21 días.

cases.claim: El repositorio Azul conserva copias de seguridad durante 12 días.

cases.sourceText: En el laboratorio ficticio Cobre, cuando la muestra está sellada, el sensor Cobre puede reportar lecturas provisionales. Solo el supervisor valida los datos definitivos; el sensor no los valida.
cases.question: ¿Quién valida los datos definitivos?
cases.claim: Solo el supervisor valida los datos definitivos.

cases.sourceText: En el laboratorio ficticio Faro, si la concentración supera 6 ppm, el laboratorio activa la ventilación. Si la concentración es de 6 ppm o menos, la ventilación permanece apagada.
cases.question: ¿Qué se activa si la concentración supera 6 ppm?
cases.claim: El laboratorio Faro activa la ventilación si la concentración supera 6 ppm.
